releaseName: Research the employer before you draft
summary: The Prepare panel can now research the employer. After you approve one run, the server searches the public web (Claude's web search by default, Linkup or off by DRAFT_LOOP_RESEARCH_SEARCH), screens each page and keeps short, dated facts with their sources (#2548, #2553, #2559, #2563, #2564, #2565, #2574). Cover letters and interview answers can cite those facts, shown as About the company (#2571). Agents get application commands, a job text tool and an opt-in drafts:read scope to read exported CVs and saved drafts (#2536, #2551, #2572). The Work journal asks for evidence-style notes and flags duplicates only on real overlap (#2558, #2561, #2562). Beta groundwork: a public landing page with a waitlist, a daily cap on model calls outside runs, and warning then erasure of inactive Beta organisations once mail is configured (#2516, #2547, #2549, #2552, #2556, #2573, #2575, #2576).
knownLimitations: A research run costs at most US$0.20 and needs the record's consent to name Anthropic. It reads search results only, not the company's own pages. The blind test of writing models (#2483) has not run. The landing page shows only when DRAFT_LOOP_BETA_ACCOUNT_CAP is set, and retention mail stays off until a Brevo key and sender are configured. Agents still cannot approve, export or start paid runs. French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs. The local-first desktop has no career interview or Prepare panel.
